title: Agreement outside a larger set
statement: Let $s\subseteq t$ be sets of integer addresses, and let $m,m'$ be memories mapping integer addresses to $W$-bit words. If $m'$ agrees with $m$ outside $s$, then it agrees with $m$ outside $t$.
